title: PATCH /api/projects/:id/todos/reorder — update todo sort order
description: Accept an ordered list of todo IDs and update their sort_order values to reflect the new order from drag-and-drop.
acceptanceCriteria: PATCH /api/projects/:id/todos/reorder requires auth and project ownership
Updates sort_order for each todo based on array position
Returns 400 if any ID does not belong to this project

steps.details: 1) getOwnedProject. 2) Validate body: orderedIds = z.array(z.string().uuid()). 3) Fetch all todos for project, extract their IDs. Verify all orderedIds are present (return 400 if any are foreign). 4) In a transaction, for each id at index i, UPDATE todos SET sort_order = i WHERE id = id. 5) Return 200.
Create 3 todos with sort_orders 0,1,2. Send reorder with reversed IDs. Verify sort_orders are now 0,1,2 in reverse order.

technicalNotes: This route must be defined BEFORE /:tid in the router to avoid Express matching 'reorder' as a :tid value
